ACME Industries reports second quarter 2026 results

Bromma, Sweden, 23 July 2026

Revenue for the second quarter was SEK 4,120 million, a decrease of 3.4 per cent compared with the same quarter last year.

Operating income was SEK 494 million, giving an operating margin of 12.0 per cent, compared with 14.1 per cent in the second quarter of 2025.

Earnings per share amounted to SEK 2.18.

Accounts receivable increased to SEK 1,980 million from SEK 1,610 million.

Inventories were SEK 1,240 million at the end of the period.

Net debt in relation to EBITDA was 2.1 times.

The company today lowers its full year 2026 revenue outlook, and now expects organic growth of minus 2 to zero per cent, compared with the previous guidance of plus 1 to plus 3 per cent.

All figures are reported and prepared in accordance with IFRS.
